map.CSAT 与 NPS 有什么区别？: How Do CSAT and NPS Differ?
map.CSAT 针对单次交互的满意度（常用 1–5 分），NPS 衡量长期推荐意愿（0: CSAT measures satisfaction with a single interaction (usually 1–5), while NPS measures long-term willingness to recommend (a 0–10 net promoter score). This tool treats CSAT scores as plain numeric data, so the NPS algorithm does not apply directly.
map.重复提交与明显乱填（如全 1 分且无文本）建议剔除后再算，并保留剔除记录；剔除规: Duplicate submissions and obvious junk (such as all 1s with no text) should be removed before computing, with the removals logged; the removal rule must be fixed or monthly data is not comparable.
map.平均分达到多少算好？: What Average Score Counts as Good?
map.行业差异较大，客服场景常见 4.0/5 以上为良好；更稳妥的做法是与自身历史基线: Varies widely by industry; in customer service a mean above 4.0 out of 5 is commonly considered good. A safer approach is to compare the trend against your own historical baseline rather than copying an external benchmark.
